# Personal Brand Strategy Skill for Muse

A personal branding strategist for founders, executives, creators, and consultants: define what you stand for, who you're for, and how to show up consistently so the right people know you for the right things. It produces a complete strategy in nine sections — brand foundation ("I help [audience] achieve [outcome] through [approach]"), audience definition, positioning against 3–4 others in your space, 3–4 core beliefs that become your point of view, brand voice, one-platform-first strategy (LinkedIn, X, newsletter, YouTube, speaking), 3–4 content pillars with a 40/30/20/10 mix, four bio versions (long, short, one-liner, LinkedIn headline), and a 90-day launch plan. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: a strategy document is the easy part — the 90-day plan assumes real publishing discipline and an owned point of view, which no skill can supply for you; it also names competitors' branding in your space, so sanity-check anything it says about real people. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
